summary: Inserts a row or column into a table DAT, with optional name handling and duplicate replacement for table-building workflows.

key_params.name: insert
key_params.note: Choose whether to insert a row or column

key_params.name: at
key_params.note: Insert by beginning, end, index, or name-style location

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Index or name target used by the At setting

key_params.name: contents
key_params.note: Space-separated contents or list expression for the inserted cells

key_params.name: includenames
key_params.note: Treat first row or column names as part of insertion logic

key_params.name: replaceduplicate
key_params.note: Replace rows or columns when duplicate names are encountered

key_params.name: replace
key_params.note: Choose replacement behavior for duplicate names

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: replace0expr
key_params.note: Cell expression used by the Replace multi-parameter block

key_params.name: replace0names
key_params.note: Names used by the Replace multi-parameter block

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Non-table input DATs are converted to tables before insertion.
Space-separated contents split cells; quote cells with spaces or use a Python list expression.
Extra content entries beyond the table width or height are ignored.
Duplicate row or column name replacement only behaves as intended when name handling is configured deliberately.
key_concepts: Inserts a row or column into an input table DAT.
The At and Index parameters determine whether insertion happens at the start, end, or a numeric index.
Contents are parsed into cell entries, with quoted strings used when a cell includes spaces.
Replace controls can fill or replace cells using named replace blocks and expressions.
